about_short_description.short_description: Zingbus is an emerging brand in the intercity bus services.

product.name: Online Bus Ticket Booking
product.description: A platform for booking bus tickets online across various routes and bus types in India.

product.name: Volvo Bus Ticket Booking
product.description: A specialized service for booking Volvo bus tickets online, including sleeper and AC Volvo buses.

product.name: On-Time Guarantee
product.description: A policy offering partial refunds if bus travel is delayed beyond 45 minutes.

product.name: Lowest Price Guarantee
product.description: A program that refunds ten times the price difference if a lower ticket price is found within 24 hours of booking.

product.name: Travel Insurance Coverage
product.description: Complimentary travel insurance providing personal accident, medical, and baggage loss coverage up to ₹7.5 lakh per trip.

product.name: Carbon-Neutral Rides
product.description: An option to offset carbon emissions from bus travel through verified carbon offset projects.
